prompt: You are writing a booklet for someone who just completed a Feldenkrais ATM lesson. This section covers Part 6: Sternum Mapping & Differentiation. The steps in this part are: Supine: Map the clavicles
text: The teacher uses tactile mapping of the clavicles and manual sliding of the sternum to help you sense the front of the chest as a mobile, independent structure. This differentiation of the breastbone from the spine clarifies the internal relationships of the rib cage, refining the function of rotation before the final integration.
